requirements.requirement: The system must include a unit test validating that Phase I input returns the lowest defined score.
The system must include a unit test validating that Phase II input returns a higher score than Phase I.
The system must include a unit test validating that Phase III input returns a higher score than Phase II.
The system must include a unit test validating that Phase IV input returns the highest defined score.
The system must include a unit test validating that 'N/A' or equivalent non-phase input returns a defined neutral or lowest score.
The system must include a unit test validating that the phase-to-score mapping function is deterministic for repeated identical inputs.
The system must include a unit test validating that all supported phase values map within the normalized score range defined by the schema.
The system must include a unit test validating that input phase values are handled case-insensitively (e.g., 'phase i' equals 'Phase I').
The system must include a unit test validating that a missing or null phase input does not throw an error and returns a safe default score.
The system must include a unit test validating that an unexpected phase value (e.g., 'Phase V') is handled gracefully without exception and returns a default score.
The system must include a unit test validating that invalid input types (e.g., numeric or object instead of string) are handled without runtime failure.
The system must ensure unit tests execute within the existing backend test framework and pass successfully.
